dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 01, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: Day of Dominant Pitching and Power Hitting**

In a day filled with impressive performances, several pitchers stood out for their dominant outings. Cristopher Sánchez of the Philadelphia Phillies tossed 6 shutout innings with 11 strikeouts, while Drew Rasmussen of the Tampa Bay Rays pitched 6 scoreless innings with 10 strikeouts to lead his team to a 1-0 victory. Logan Gilbert of the Seattle Mariners went 7 innings strong, allowing 3 earned runs and striking out 6. Parker Messick of the Arizona Diamondbacks also pitched 4.1 innings, striking out 6 and allowing 1 earned run.

On the hitting side, several players showed off their power. Geraldo Perdomo of the Arizona Diamondbacks went 4-6 with a home run and 3 RBIs, while Hunter Goodman of the Colorado Rockies hit 2 home runs and drove in 5 runs. Ceddanne Rafaela of the Boston Red Sox hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs to lead his team to a 3-2 victory.
